description: This file defines the PDUFormatBuilder class used for constructing PDU format strings for sending SMS messages in a Cuttlefish modem simulator. It includes methods to set user data and sender number, and to build the final PDU string, adhering to GSM 03.40 specifications.

classes.name: PDUFormatBuilder
classes.description: A class for building PDU format strings used in SMS transmission within the Cuttlefish modem simulator.

methods.name: SetUserData
methods.description: Sets the user data to be included in the PDU string.

methods.name: SetSenderNumber
methods.description: Sets the sender's phone number in the PDU string.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the PDU format string based on the set parameters; returns an empty string if required fields are invalid.
